topic: GTA 6: the seven-minute tower climb, the egg nest cutscene and its Vice City 2002 callback
title: What's at the top of GTA 6's longest ladder? #shorts
lines: What's at the top of GTA 6's longest ladder?
It's a giant radio tower in Leonida.
Climbing it takes about seven minutes, over triple Metal Gear Solid 3's famous ladder.
At the top sits a bird's nest full of huge, colorful eggs.
Throw one at the road, and a secret cutscene plays.
The egg spirals like a football and splatters a driver on his phone.
In 2002, Vice City hid a chocolate Easter egg in a secret room.
Twenty-four years later, Rockstar made the Easter egg an actual egg.
So if you find a ladder that never ends, you know what's up there.
description: GTA 6 hides a seven-minute ladder climb with a very literal reward at the top, and it's a callback 24 years in the making. #gta6 #gtavi #eastereggs #gaming #shorts
